title: Arthropod and Invertebrate Pests

sourceControl.sourceTitle: THC Cannabis Encyclopedia — Master Content Map v1.0 — Part 15
sourceControl.rule: Preserve permanent THC-ENC IDs and controlled titles; identify pests from specimens, life stages, injury patterns, and sampling evidence; do not convert pest identity into pesticide authorization or universal action thresholds.

educationalBoundary: Plant identification and lawful integrated-pest-management education only. Pesticide, biopesticide, disinfectant, and other regulated product use remains governed by current labels, registrations, worker-safety requirements, residue rules, and jurisdictional law. The presence of a pest or vector does not by itself establish crop-loss severity, disease infection, or a treatment requirement.
